title: Terms of use
intro: These terms are part of a fictional portfolio demo. Ferrowind Partners is not a real company, and nothing on this site is a commercial offer.

sections.heading: Demo purpose
paragraphs: This site exists to demonstrate a static corporate website built with the Folio starter kit. Services, pricing, clients, case studies, and testimonials are invented for that purpose.
Do not present this demo as a real engineering firm or imply that it can provide professional services.

sections.heading: No professional advice
paragraphs: Engineering descriptions, metrics, and recommendations are illustrative. They are not a substitute for a site-specific assessment by a licensed professional.
Any real industrial change should be reviewed against local safety, environmental, and engineering requirements.

sections.heading: Content and trademarks
paragraphs: Demo copy and illustrations were created for this portfolio. No real company logos or trademarks are used.
Client names such as Brackenhill Metals, Northvale Pulp, and Calder Cement Works are fictional.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
paragraphs: You may browse, test, and reference this demo for learning. You may not represent it as a live commercial site or reuse the fictional brand as your own.
The demo is provided as-is, without warranties of any kind.
